newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firmer but fuel oil sluggish.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer but fuel oil sluggish.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly firmer on Tuesday morning, except fuel oil barges which moved little from Monday's close, dealers said.

Gasoline was about $1 on physical and swaps. Eurograde barges were offered at $187 fob Rotterdam and regular at $180 fob Rotterdam, but bids were some way lower than these levels. Traders continued to describe the market as uncertain.

Heating oil barges were up $1/$2 as IPE July gas oil futures gained. Premiums were broadly unchanged, at IPE July +$1 fob Rotterdam offered for prompt heating oil and +$6 for diesel. Demand in the key German market was still weak.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded in the range $85-$85.50 for lower grade RMG material and at $86 fob Rotterdam a couple of times for running refinery product.
The prices were similar to those seen late on Monday, but buying was a little more concerted. Bunker demand improved from Monday, but was still not high.
